review_scope: Exact native clean-X source replay, source-row support unions on nested chart chains, target-first U<=2 turn-interval caps, and directed reversal-budget arithmetic. These are scoped movement/support relaxations, not a full completion impossibility theorem.

review_findings.movement_price_identity: Nine Hub-to-zero packets with total upward MOVE rank U have total MOVE rank at least 72+2U.
review_findings.fixed_clean_minimum_y_packet_gate: Directed rank-price arithmetic excludes U>=3 by >0.2307843603357546 from the limiting Q ceiling; hence U<=2 in this retained caller.
review_findings.scope: Source-chain caps optimistically union every observed X history row at each visited chart and do not assert one packet realizes that union. Target-first caps require turn-interval source charts to contain the lower turn chart and exclude cache reads exactly at the upper endpoint. Hub or other upper-endpoint reads can carry nonlocal values and are not ruled out. The optional 102-arrival deficit is conditional on its separate event-count premise. No architecture-wide no-go is claimed.
